title: Reverse Linked List
description: Given the `head` of a singly linked list represented as an array of values, reverse the list, and return the reversed list.

hints.content: Iterate through the list while maintaining a reference to the previous element.
In an iterative pointer approach, prev = null, curr = head. At each step, next = curr.next, curr.next = prev, prev = curr, curr = next.
For array representation, reversing in-place or unshifting produces the reversed sequence.

solution.explanation:
Reverse the linked list elements in linear time.
Time Complexity: O(n)
Space Complexity: O(n)
